note: Read both RFC 8654 Section 6 paragraphs with Sections 3-5: the common minimum remains, the 65535 maximum applies only after receiver advertisement, and OPEN/KEEPALIVE are excluded. All five tagged functions were re-read. TestValidateLengthWithMax and TestRFC8654LengthBoundsPerTypeAndCapability accept per-type minima and 4096 boundaries, accept 65535 for extended UPDATE/NOTIFICATION/ROUTE-REFRESH, reject 0/18 and standard 4097, reject OPEN 4097/65535 even with extension and KEEPALIVE 20, and identify Bad Message Length, including erroneous Length in the boundary helper. TestRFC8654ExtendedMessageDirections tests all four advertisement combinations and independently pins receive/send permission in negotiated and encoding views. TestRFC8654ReceiveLimitFollowsLocalOPEN drives actual OPENs and both session readers at 4096/4097/65535 with complete-payload equality or exact 1/2 plus offending Length and no dispatch. Its rejected sender receive only joins completion; the wire and dispatch predicates remain the proof. TestRFC8654AnnouncementAccumulation uses individually standard-sized announcements to isolate batching rather than header admission, requiring exact consumer batches through 65535, overflow splitting, KEEPALIVE flush, empty-flush nonduplication and continued Established state. The producers are directional capability.Negotiate, Session.negotiateWith, Header.ValidateLengthWithMax and the single/coalesced readers. The comment-only receive change loses no proof or boundary. No native tests were executed in this audit.
